title: Peruvian Beef Lomo Saltado
description: A classic Peruvian stir-fry dish made with beef strips, onions, tomatoes, and French fries. Serve with steamed rice.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the beef strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil to the skillet. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the diced aji amarillo pepper and cook for an additional minute.
Add the French fries and cook until they start to brown, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the sliced tomato and cook until they start to soften, about 2 minutes.
Return the cooked beef strips to the skillet and stir in the soy sauce, Peruvian aji panca sauce, salt, and black pepper.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened and the beef is coated.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro or scallions if desired.
Serve with steamed rice to soak up the flavorful sauce.
Garnish with sliced aji amarillo peppers and chopped cilantro if desired.
